Fit an OpenMx pedigree model to observed data

Source: R/buildmxPedigrees.R
fitPedigreeModel.Rd

This function constructs and fits an OpenMx model for a pedigree using specified variance components and family group models.

Usage

fitPedigreeModel(
  model_name = "PedigreeModel",
  vars = list(ad2 = 0.5, dd2 = 0.3, cn2 = 0.2, ce2 = 0.4, mt2 = 0.1, am2 = 0.25, ee2 =
    0.6),
  data = NULL,
  group_models = NULL,
  Addmat = NULL,
  Nucmat = NULL,
  Extmat = NULL,
  Mtdmat = NULL,
  Amimat = NULL,
  Dmgmat = NULL,
  tryhard = TRUE,
  intervals = TRUE,
  extraTries = 10,
  condenseMatrixSlots = TRUE,
  runmodel = TRUE,
  temporal = FALSE,
  dat_list = NULL,
  obs_ids_list = NULL,
  param_year_list = NULL,
  H_list = NULL,
  Addmat_list = NULL,
  Nucmat_list = NULL,
  Extmat_list = NULL,
  Mtdmat_list = NULL,
  Amimat_list = NULL,
  Dmgmat_list = NULL,
  p_hist = NULL,
  components = c("a", "d", "cn", "ce", "mt", "am", "e"),
  use_exp_loadings = FALSE,
  time_point_max = NULL,
  start_beta0 = 0.5,
  start_beta_time = 0,
  start_gamma = 0,
  mean_degree = 0,
  start_mean = 0,
  mean_hist_free = FALSE,
  start_mean_hist = 0,
  retain_eta = TRUE,
  retain_loadings = TRUE,
  retain_loading_covariances = TRUE,
  retain_component_covariances = TRUE,
  residual_covariance_form = c("outer_product", "diagonal"),
  clean_ids = TRUE,
  group_static_families = FALSE
)

Arguments

model_name

Character. Name for the overall OpenMx model. Default is "PedigreeModel".

vars

A named list or vector of initial variance component values. Only used when temporal = FALSE.

data

A matrix or data frame of observed data, where each row is a family and columns correspond to individuals. Only used when group_models is NULL and temporal = FALSE.

group_models

Optional list of pre-built OpenMx family group models (from buildOneFamilyGroup). If NULL, they are generated from data (or, when temporal = TRUE, from dat_list and friends) using the provided relatedness matrices.

Addmat

Additive genetic relatedness matrix (from ped2add).

Nucmat

Nuclear family shared environment relatedness matrix (from ped2cn).

Extmat

Common extended family environment relatedness matrix. When non-NULL, a Vce term scaled by this matrix is added to the covariance. If a non-matrix value (e.g. TRUE) is supplied, a unit matrix (all members share equally) is created automatically.

Mtdmat

Mitochondrial genetic relatedness matrix (from ped2mit).

Amimat

Additive by mitochondrial interaction relatedness matrix.

Dmgmat

Dominance genetic relatedness matrix.

tryhard

Logical. If TRUE (default), use mxTryHard for robust optimization; if FALSE, use mxRun.

intervals

Logical. If TRUE (default), compute confidence intervals for the parameters using mxSE and mxCI.

extraTries

Numeric. The number of extra optimization attempts to make when tryhard is TRUE. Default is 10.

condenseMatrixSlots

Logical. If TRUE, use the mxCondenseMatrixSlots wrapper to optimize memory usage for large matrices. Default is TRUE.

runmodel

Logical. If TRUE (default), the model is fitted; if FALSE, the model is returned without fitting.

temporal

Logical. If TRUE, build a time-varying family-group model where each component's weight is a function of param_year (and, optionally, H) instead of a fixed scalar. Default is FALSE.

dat_list

A list of numeric vectors of observed data, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

obs_ids_list

A list of character vectors of individual IDs, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

param_year_list

A list of numeric birth-year vectors, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

H_list

A list of historical-moderator matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE.

Addmat_list

A list of additive genetic relatedness matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

Nucmat_list

A list of nuclear family shared environment relatedness matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

Extmat_list

A list of common extended family environment relatedness matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

Mtdmat_list

A list of mitochondrial genetic relatedness matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

Amimat_list

A list of additive by mitochondrial interaction relatedness matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

Dmgmat_list

A list of dominance genetic relatedness matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE and group_models is NULL.

p_hist

Integer. Number of historical moderator columns. Only used when temporal = TRUE. If NULL, inferred from H_list.

components

Character vector of component keys to include (any of "a", "d", "cn", "ce", "mt", "am", "e"). Only used when temporal = TRUE. Default is c("a", "e").

use_exp_loadings

Logical. If TRUE (default), each component's loading is exponentiated so its implied variance stays positive. Only used when temporal = TRUE.

time_point_max

Integer degree of the polynomial birth-year basis. Only used when temporal = TRUE. Default is 3.

start_beta0

Numeric. Starting value for each component's intercept loading. Only used when temporal = TRUE. Default is 0.5.

start_beta_time

Numeric. Starting value for each component's time-slope loadings. Only used when temporal = TRUE. Default is 0.

start_gamma

Numeric. Starting value for historical-moderator loadings. Only used when temporal = TRUE. Default is 0.

mean_degree

Integer. Degree of the polynomial temporal mean. The default, 0, estimates a constant mean. Must not exceed time_point_max.

start_mean

Numeric. Starting value for the mean's intercept. Set this near the observed phenotype mean.

mean_hist_free

Logical, length 1 or p_hist. Whether historical moderators can shift the phenotypic mean. Defaults to FALSE, fixing those shifts at zero.

start_mean_hist

Numeric. Starting value for the free elements of G_mean.

retain_eta

Logical. Retain named temporal linear predictors Eta_*.

retain_loadings

Logical. Retain named loading vectors L_*.

retain_loading_covariances

Logical. Retain named loading outer products K*.

retain_component_covariances

Logical. Retain named relatedness-weighted component covariance algebras Cov_*. Any unretained layer is inlined, leaving V and the likelihood unchanged.

residual_covariance_form

Character. Use "outer_product" to preserve the original I * K_e representation or "diagonal" for the exactly equivalent vec2diag(L_e * L_e) representation.

clean_ids

Logical. If TRUE, clean the obs_ids to be syntactically valid R names using make.names. Default is FALSE.

group_static_families

Logical. If TRUE for a static model built from data, build one raw-data submodel containing all family rows. If FALSE, preserve the original one-submodel-per-family implementation.

Value

A fitted OpenMx model.
